general.title: PacSun CEO: Brands Mean a Lot to Young People Today
general.summary: Brieane Olson, CEO of PacSun, says that the retailer’s core customer is 16 to 24, while it is also tracking differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Drawing on a PacSun Youth Report conducted with GlobalData and surveying 6,000 young people, Olson said mental health ranks as their top priority. general.title: New Balance CEO Joe Preston on NYC Marathon Partnership
general.summary: Joe Preston, New Balance President and CEO, discussed the company’s long-running partnership with the New York City Marathon, which he described as a key part of the brand. More than 300 New Balance associates are in the city for race week, including 200 retail staff at the Javits Center expo, where more than 100,000 visitors are expected over three days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Meta’s Rating Outlook Cut to Negative by S&P on AI Spending
general.summary: S&P Global Ratings took an early step toward potentially downgrading Meta Platforms Inc.’s credit rating within the next two years, amid growing pressure on the tech company’s balance sheet stemming from elevated spending tied to artificial intelligence.

general.title: Ice Cube on Big3 League: In a Great Position To Scale
general.summary: Ice Cube, CEO & Co-Founder of the Big3 basketball league, says audiences want more basketball in the summer and argues that the league has helped professionalize three-on-three play. He describes basketball as a globally beloved sport and say the league is well positioned to grow, noting that it is already recognized as the world’s premier professional three-on-three league. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Burger King US President on Sales Turnaround
general.summary: Burger King US and Canada President Tom Curtis discussed the chain’s comparable-sales growth, cited in the conversation as 8.4%, against an estimate of 6.2%. Curtis said growth is being driven largely by customers who had stopped visiting and are now returning, drawn by a renewed connection to the brand. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Need To Rethink How AI Infrastructure Is Powered: FuelCell Energy CEO
general.summary: FuelCell Energy President and CEO Jason Few discusses public concerns over higher utility bills, water use and fossil-fuel infrastructure. Discussing a proposed project in Newport Township, Pennsylvania, where FuelCell Energy would supply power but is not the developer, Few said communities should have a say and projects should be judged on their actual effects—not rejected simply because they are data centers. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close."

general.title: France Gets Budget Warning as Fitch Turns Negative on Rating
general.summary: France’s credit score was put on a negative outlook by Fitch Ratings, an unscheduled move that highlights how quickly the country’s public finances are souring.

general.title: Opay Shares Fail to Trade After Raising $304 Million in US IPO
general.summary: Shares of Opay Ltd., a Nigeria-focused payments platform, didn’t begin trading in New York as expected after the company raised $304 million in a US initial public offering priced at the bottom of the range.

general.title: Illumina CEO on Q3 Results and Business Outlook
general.summary: Jacob Thaysen says Illumina delivered a strong third quarter, beat expectations and raised its fourth-quarter outlook. He said the company has moved from essentially flat performance to mid-single-digit growth over the past 18 months and remains committed to its high-single-digit growth target for 2027, with clinical business serving as the main growth driver. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
